title: Bye Bye PERSPECTIVE API: Lessons for Measurement Infrastructure in NLP, CSS and LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing independent audits that measure the disproportionate flagging (over-moderation) of identity-related content, reclaimed slurs, and text associated with marginalized groups (e.g., LGBTQIA+ communities).

Synthesizing research that compares toxicity scores for comparable content across different languages, such as highlighting elevated toxicity ratings for German-language text compared to other languages.
Citing literature that documents cross-geographic disparities in the performance and outcomes of toxicity detection systems.
Highlighting systemic errors in measurement systems and benchmarks that encode the over-moderation of specific linguistic dialects.
